problem_1_scene_wiring.symptom: MOVIE_SPATIAL_ENGINE_V1 / MOVIE_SPATIAL_GRAPH_V1 / MOVIE_REPLICA_ACCURACY_V1 reports showed spirited_away at 0 scenes/coordinates/nodes while titanic showed 300 across every metric.
problem_1_scene_wiring.method: Read services/movieReplicaDatasetBuilder.ts::resolveSceneList() and diffed the real on-disk titanic and spirited_away reconstruction bundles field-by-field.
problem_1_scene_wiring.finding: resolveSceneList()'s non-titanic fallback reads bundle.scene_registry as an embedded object (matches titanic's bundle shape). exports/movie_datasets/spirited_away/spirited_away_movie_reconstruction_bundle.json instead carries only scene_registry_ref (a path string) -- bundle.scene_registry is undefined, so the fallback silently returns [].

problem_2_motion_temporal_layer_wiring.symptom: After fixing problem_1, spirited_away's 300 replica entries all showed TRAJECTORY_COUNT_ZERO / POSE_COUNT_ZERO / CAMERA_TIMELINE_COUNT_ZERO / TEMPORAL_SEGMENT_COUNT_ZERO.
problem_2_motion_temporal_layer_wiring.method: Traced titanic's real motion/timeline/temporal sources (bundle.camera_motion_layer.registry_ref, bundle.titanic_dense_layer.body_pose_registry_ref, bundle.shot_layer.shot_registry, bundle.temporal_layer.*), then checked whether an equivalent real source existed for spirited_away before assuming MISSING_REAL_SOURCE.
problem_2_motion_temporal_layer_wiring.finding: Real, already-generated registries existed on disk (datasets/movie_reconstruction/spirited_away_motion/*.json: camera_motion_count=300, subject_motion_count=600; datasets/movie_reconstruction/spirited_away_shots/spirited-away-shot-registry.json: shot_count=2400; datasets/movie_reconstruction/spirited_away_temporal/*.json: sequence_count=300, transition_count=2399) but spiritedAwayMovieDataset.ts::buildBundle() never added the corresponding motion_layer/shot_layer/temporal_layer keys, even though the bundle was regenerated (2026-09-02T02:25:20Z) after all of those source registries already existed (2026-08-09 / 2026-09-01). Confirmed as a wiring gap, not MISSING_REAL_SOURCE.

problem_3_transition_consumption.symptom: After fixing problem_1 and problem_2, all count-based validations PASSed, but a targeted audit of the built scene-graph artifacts showed spirited_away's timeline_edges contained 0 edge_type:'scene_transition_link' entries versus titanic's 598, despite spirited_away's temporal_transition_registry holding 2399 real transition records.
problem_3_transition_consumption.method: Traced movieReplicaSceneGraphBuilder.ts's consumption of temporal_registry_v2.segments and confirmed field-name divergence between titanic's real transitions (from_scene/to_scene) and spirited_away's real transitions (from_scene_id/to_scene_id, plus from_shot/to_shot at a finer shot-level granularity).
problem_3_transition_consumption.finding: 299 of the 2399 spirited_away transition records are genuine inter-scene transitions (from_scene_id !== to_scene_id) -- exactly matching titanic's 299 scene-to-scene transitions in count and semantic role. The remaining 2100 are intra-scene shot-cut transitions (from_scene_id === to_scene_id), a finer-grained unit titanic's registry does not carry. A PASS verdict at the count-only temporal_segment_count gate was already satisfied by the sequences data alone, silently masking the fact that the entire real transitions evidence type was unconsumed.

fix_1_scene_registry_ref_fallback.change: Added one fallback branch between the titanic special case and the existing bundle.scene_registry fallback: if bundle.scene_registry_ref is a string and the referenced file exists, read it and return its .scenes array.

fix_2_motion_shot_temporal_layer_embeddi.change: Added a root parameter; embedded the already-existing real registries (spirited_away_motion/spirited-away-camera-motion-registry.json, spirited_away_motion/spirited-away-subject-motion-registry.json, spirited_away_shots/spirited-away-shot-registry.json, spirited_away_temporal/spirited-away-shot-sequence-registry.json, spirited_away_temporal/spirited-away-temporal-transition-registry.json) under bundle.motion_layer / bundle.shot_layer / bundle.temporal_layer, matching the exact key shapes movieReplicaDatasetBuilder.ts's existing non-titanic fallbacks already expect. No new data generated; only existing files read and re-embedded.
fix_2_motion_shot_temporal_layer_embeddi.call_site_updated: materializeDataset(): buildBundle(scenes, anchors, generatedAt) -> buildBundle(root, scenes, anchors, generatedAt)

fix_3_transition_inter_scene_compatibili.change: filterTransitionsByScene() extended to fall back to from_scene_id/to_scene_id when from_scene/to_scene are absent, and to exclude any entry where the resolved from/to values are equal (excludes spirited_away's 2100 intra-scene shot-cut entries as self-loops, not scene transitions). movieReplicaSceneGraphBuilder.ts's scene_transition_link edge builder given the same from_scene_id/to_scene_id fallback for source_ref/target_ref. Titanic's from_scene/to_scene path is checked first and is a no-op change for it.

verification.method: Live re-execution via tsx of the real verify scripts (scripts/verify-movie-replica-dataset.ts, verify-movie-replica-scene-graph.ts, verify-movie-spatial-engine.ts, verify-movie-spatial-graph.ts, verify-movie-replica-accuracy.ts) after each fix, plus direct field counts read from the resulting dataset/report JSON on disk.

transition_recovery.source: datasets/movie_replica/{titanic,spirited_away}/*-movie-replica-scene-graph.json, counted directly from scene_graphs[].timeline_edges[] where edge_type=='scene_transition_link'

titanic_regression.note: Byte-for-byte unaffected: titanic's bundle carries no scene_registry_ref/motion_layer-shaped-differently/from_scene_id keys, so every new fallback branch is a no-op for it.

canonical_history_dedup_check.method: retrieveCanonicalHistoryByProblem({ problem }) invoked live against the real canonical corpus (default readers, no fixtures) for 23 distinct query phrases covering the three candidate lessons.
canonical_history_dedup_check.conclusion: No duplicate. exp_movie_factory_evidence_integrity_correction_v1 shares the broader 'PASS is not proof of ground truth' family but diagnoses a different failure mechanism (self-referential/synthetic VALUES vs. a substitute real evidence-type masking non-consumption of the intended real evidence-type) -- linked via related_but_distinct_from rather than treated as a duplicate.

regression.note: Actual pass/fail per-script output captured at capture time; see the session's tool transcript for raw stdout of each script.
